# PhillyVoice

> PhillyVoice is Philadelphia and South Jersey's comprehensive local news, sports, culture, and lifestyle hub covering breaking news, Philadelphia sports teams, entertainment, events, health, and community features.

PhillyVoice serves the Philadelphia metropolitan area and South Jersey with coverage spanning news, sports (Eagles, Phillies, Sixers, Flyers), culture, entertainment, dining, events, and health topics. The site combines breaking news reporting with lifestyle features, event guides, and community interest stories.

## Core News & Content Hubs

- [PhillyVoice Homepage](https://www.phillyvoice.com): PhillyVoice homepage: Philadelphia and South Jersey news, sports, culture hub
- [News](https://www.phillyvoice.com/news): Philadelphia news, local news, national news, politics, weather and more
- [Sports](https://www.phillyvoice.com/sports): Latest Philadelphia Sports headlines, scores, commentary and analysis
- [Culture](https://www.phillyvoice.com/culture): Entertainment, lifestyle, parenting, restaurants, music, nightlife in the Philadelphia area
- [Health](https://www.phillyvoice.com/health): Health news covering medicine, fitness, nutrition, wellness, and disease
- [Events](https://www.phillyvoice.com/events): Guide to things to do in the Philadelphia area and South Jersey suburbs
